# Method: derive the sound rules from the attested pairs, apply them to *ʔikat,

# Standard library only; no file, network, or subprocess access.

# Attested Proto-Chamic -> Tsat pairs (Tsat written with ASCII tone digits)
evidence = [
    ("*ʔikaːn", "kaːn33"),   # fish
    ("*ʔiduŋ",  "thuŋ11"),   # nose
    ("*ʔurat",  "zaʔ24"),    # tendon
    ("*dikiʔ",  "kiʔ42"),    # few
    ("*labaːt", "phaːʔ42"),  # to walk
    ("*batuk",  "tuʔ42"),    # to cough
    ("*rataːk", "taːʔ24"),   # beans
    ("*masam",  "saːnʔ42"),  # vinegar
    ("*padam",  "thaːnʔ42"), # to extinguish
]

def split_tone(form):
    base, _, tone = form.partition("^")
    # Tone digits are the trailing digits of the Tsat string
    i = len(form)
    while i > 0 and form[i - 1].isdigit():
        i -= 1
    return form[:i], form[i:]

print("Attested Tsat syllables (base, tone):")
stopped = []
for pc, ts in evidence:
    base, tone = split_tone(ts)
    print(f"  {pc:10s} -> {base:8s} tone {tone}")
    if pc.endswith(("t", "k", "ʔ")):
        stopped.append((pc, base, tone))

# Rule 1: Proto-Chamic initial *ʔi- is lost in Tsat (*ʔikaːn, *ʔiduŋ, *ʔurat)
initial_loss = all(not base.startswith(("i", "u")) or pc[1] not in "iu"
                   for pc, base in [(p, split_tone(t)[0]) for p, t in evidence if p.startswith("*ʔ")])
print("Rule 1 (initial *ʔV- lost):", initial_loss)

# Rule 2: Proto-Chamic final -t and -k (and -ʔ) surface as Tsat -ʔ
final_glottal = all(base.endswith("ʔ") for _, base, _ in stopped)
print("Rule 2 (stop finals -> -ʔ):", final_glottal)

# Rule 3: stopped syllables carry tone 42 or 24, never 33 or 11
stopped_tones = {tone for _, _, tone in stopped}
allowed_tones = {"42", "24"}
print("Stopped-syllable tones observed:", sorted(stopped_tones))
print("Rule 3 (stopped tones in {42,24}):", stopped_tones <= allowed_tones)

# Apply rules to *ʔikat
pc_form = "*ʔikat"

after_final = after_initial[:-1] + "ʔ"            # -t -> -ʔ
derived_bases = {after_final}
derived_candidates = {b + t for b in derived_bases for t in allowed_tones}
print("Derived base for *ʔikat:", after_final)
print("Derived candidates:", sorted(derived_candidates))

# Test the submitted answer
submitted = "kat33"
sub_base, sub_tone = split_tone(submitted)

base_ok = sub_base in derived_bases
tone_ok = sub_tone in allowed_tones
print("Base matches derived base:", base_ok)
print("Tone matches stopped-syllable tones:", tone_ok)

if base_ok and tone_ok:
    print("CHECK PASS")
elif not base_ok or not tone_ok:
